facts.fact: Law 2013-015 was adopted by the National Assembly on 9 May 2013 and promulgated on 21 May 2013; the text states no commencement date.
facts.system: Loi n°2013-015 du 21 mai 2013 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Article 20 institutes the APDP as an independent administrative authority of 15 members designated by named bodies, with members' list fixed by decree.
